Commentary.Commentary: That's it from us today. Pakistan cricket team are all smiles as they lift the trophy. They keep their number one ranking and will look to stay on top. Hope you enjoyed our coverage as much as we enjoyed bringing it to you. Till next time, take care and cheers!

Sarfraz Ahmed, the victorious Pakistan skipper, is all praises for the Almighty. He states that the team is always looking to be consistent and the boys are doing well. He continues saying they take one game at a time and play every game with high spirits. He further opines that it will be good for his team if they continue to get this kind of support every time. Ends by thanking the home crowd and the groundstaff for their efforts.

Jason Mohammed, the Windies skipper, says that this was the team's best game of the series. He continues saying that the whole team is young and it was a good learning curve. Ends by saying his stay was good in Pakistan and is looking forward for another tour.

Man of the Series, Babar Azam, says that he had planned to win the Man of the Series Trophy before the series and did that. He says that he shares his knowledge with the youngsters and gets helpful tips from the seniors.

Man of the Match, Fakhar Zaman, says that he tries to play well every game and is happy when he does so. He adds that he gets expertise from the captain and the coach on how to go about his game. On dealing in boundaries, he says that he now also tries to pick up singles as well. He ends by saying that they get confidence being the number one side.

Hussain Talat is seen having a chat with Rameez Raja. He starts by thanking the lord for the success. Adds that he always played in his building, so he wanted to play with everything he had whenever he got the chance on the big stage. States that everyone in the team gives him a lot of confidence, so it always helps. Continues saying that when he watched all the big teams come to Pakistan earlier in his childhood, he dreamed of playing against them in front of the home crowd, so is happy he got the chance to do it now. Admits he never thought he would get the opportunity to represent his country, but wants to take it with both hands now that he's got it. Feels he has worked on his bowling a lot and also, when asked about his batting position, he says that wherever the team needs him to, he will play there.

Windies displayed a better performance with the bat today but the show with the ball was the same. They never picked up wickets at regular intervals and allowed the Pakistan batsmen to settle in. Their fielding, like in all the previous games, was poor again. Lots of lessons to take for them when they fly back home. For now, the Men in Green will celebrate their series win with their home fans and cherish this moment as cricket has returned to their country after a long time. Stay tuned for the presentation.

Another comprehensive win by the hosts. Dominated the visitors today as well and got across the line with ease. Hussain Talat and Asif Ali ensured that no further damage was caused and finished things off comfortably. Early on, Fakhar Zaman and Babar Azam gave Pakistan a fiery start. The former fell short of his fifty but the latter got his second half century in two matches.
FOUR! That's it! Short ball on off, Talat gets behind the ball and pulls it to the fine leg region for a boundary. PAKISTAN WIN BY 8 WICKETS!
Finds the fielder at point this time. Dot ball.
Played to the point region by Ali. One run added to the total.
SIX! Don't bowl there to Asif. He will pull you all day. Another short ball on off, Asif pulls this over mid-wicket for a biggie. Just a hit away now, are Pakistan.
FOUR! Digs this one short on middle and off, Asif pulls it behind square leg for a boundary.
Keemo Paul to bowl the 17th over.
Length outside off, Talat hangs back and looks to push it to the off side but gets beaten.
Ali opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A short delivery which has been pulled away by Talat. The batsmen have run through for a single. 16 off 26 now needed.
Asif guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Another couple of runs. Easy pickings for the hosts. This ball is flicked to the deep again for two runs.
Full again on the leg side, Ali flicks it to deep square leg for a brace.
Full on middle, Ali shuffles across and works it through mid-wicket for a run. 22 more needed from the last 5 overs.
Wide. The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact. The umpire has signalled a wide.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, Asif cuts it late towards the wide third man region where Emrit cannot get to the ball. 24 off 31 now.
Wide! Bangs this one short and it goes well over the head of Ali. The umpire signals a wide.
Pulls this in front of square to the deep mid-wicket region. One run added to the total.
Full on middle and leg, Talat works this through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Pakistan are doing it quite comfortably here.
Ali opens the face of his bat and guides to to the third man region for one more.
Odean Smith comes in to bowl again.
Talat square cuts this behind backward point to get to the other end.
Length ball on off, Ali gets behind the ball and is happy to defend it. 34 more off 36 balls needed.
Angles this on the legs of Ali once again who works it around the corner for a dot.
FOUR LEG BYES! Strays this on the pads of Ali who helps it on its way for a boundary. Leg byes signalled by the umpire.
Asif shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Length around off, Talat cuts it past point for one more.
Full on the leg side, Ali flicks it through square leg for one.
Rayad Emrit comes back for another spell.
Ali works it down the leg side and gets off the mark.
Asif Ali is the next man in.

OUT! Fifty and out! Effort ball from Smith and Azam looks to hook this over square leg. Doesn't time it well enough and finds Walton stationed there in the deep who takes it in a reverse cup. Another wonderful innings from Babar comes to an end. He will be unhappy that he couldn't take his side all the way through.
FOUR! What a way to get to your fifty! Full around off, Azam drives this superbly through covers for back-to-back fifties! It's his 5th in this format.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side, but it finds the fielder.
Full and outside off, Talat does well to put bat on it and slices it behind backward point for a single.
Serves this full on middle, Azam pushes this towards mid on and gets to the other end.
Played through mid-wicket by Babar. The batsmen have run through for a single. Pakistan need 47 in 48 and they are doing it with ease.
Tossed up in line of the stumps, Talat hits this to mid on.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Cuts this late to the short third man fielder.
Full on off, Babar whips this through mid-wicket where Emrit misfields. They steal a couple of runs off it.
FOUR! 100 up for the hosts. Get there in style after a poor ball outside off is cut through backward point.
Cuts this through point but the ball won't go all the way to the fence. They manage to come back for the second.
Uses his feet to hit this ball towards long on for one.
Full on middle, Talat plays it with soft hands to the leg side and gets to the other end.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! Skids after pitching outside off, Talat crouches and cuts this through backward point. The ball races away to the fence.
Tosses this one up, Azam drives this through mid off to rotate strike.
Azam pulls this towards mid-wicket to end the over with a single. Just 3 runs from this over.
Charges down and slices it over point for just one.
Another dot ball. Tossed up around off, Talat goes for the big heave but gets an inside edge fine down the leg side for nothing.
Talat gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Another short ball, Azam rocks back and pushes this to the off side for one.
Slow short ball on off, Azam will be disappointed he found the fielder at point.
Andre McCarthy, the debutant, gets the ball in hand.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. One run added to the total. 68 runs from 66 balls needed for Pakistan now.
Floated ball on leg, Azam hits this through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Gives this one air, Talat comes down and takes it on the full. Gets it off the inner half towards mid on for a single.
Easy singles for the hosts. Another punch towards mid off for one.
Slower through the air on off, Talat plays this through mid off for one more.
Full on middle, Azam drives this to long off and gives his partner the strike.
A single to end the over. Not a bad one from the skipper. Azam punches this to long off and will retain the strike.
Short of a length ball on middle, Talat pushes this towards covers and gets to the other end.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Pitches this one further on off, Azam finds the fielder at point.
FOUR! This one is too short outside off, Azam rocks back and pulls this through mid-wicket.
Short ball around off, Talat punches this towards mid off for a run.
Jason Mohammed, the skipper, brings himself on.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Short ball outside off, Talat gets low and slices it through the gap past backward point for a boundary.
Full on off this time, Azam drives this through mid off for one more.
Full on leg, Talat works it on the leg side for one.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Talat misses his flick and the ball hits him on his pad down leg. The ball rolls to the leg side and after a hesitation the batsmen decide to run through. Ramdin hares to the ball and collects it. He has an under arm throw to the non-striker's end and misses his target. Had he taken proper aim, Talat would have been a goner.
Good length ball around off, Azam looks to fiddle with it but gets beaten. End of the Powerplay, Pakistan are 62/1.
Hussain plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Back of a length ball on the pads of Talat who misses his nudge and gets hits high on the thigh pad.
Welcomes him with a bouncer. Short ball on leg, Talat does well to sway away from it.
Hussain Talat walks in next to bat.

OUT! A much-needed wicket for the tourists. They need more of this quickly. Seeing Fakhar charging down, Emrit shortens his length a tad and serves this around off. Zaman looks to pull this away but only manages to get a feather to it. The ball settles in the gloves of Ramdin and they all go up in celebration. An entertaining innings from the opener comes to an end. 93 more needed for the hosts.
FOUR! Darts this full around off, Zaman drives it uppishly wide of the fielder at mid off to the fence.
Azam dances down the track but decides to defend it.
Another couple of runs taken from the batsmen. Full on leg, Azam pushes it gently through mid-wicket and will get two for it.
Finds the gap this time. Flicks this ball through square leg for a brace.
Sloer ball on middle, Azam works it to the leg side for a dot.
Floats this one too in line of the stumps. Zaman charges down and hits it towards sweeper cover for just one.
Tosses this one full on middle, Azam taps it around the corner for one.
Samuel Badree to roll his arm now.
FOUR! Fifty partnership for the hosts! And just in the fourth over. Another back of a length ball on off, Zaman makes room and slaps this over mid-wicket for a one bounce boundary.
SIX! HUGE! Slow ball on middle, Fakhar picks it up and lofts it over the bowler's head for a maximum. Holds his pose on his followthrough. He is looking very good here.
Full again in line of the stumps, Zaman hits this to the fielder standing at mid on.
Bowls this full on leg, Babar milks it through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Not learning from his first ball is Smith. Drags this one short too, Azam hands back and punches this through cover-point for back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Poor ball to start with. Digs this in short and wide outside off, Azam hops and upper cuts this towards third man for a boundary.
Odean Smith to bowl his first over.
Short ball, Azam pulls this front of square and will retain strike for the next over. A big over for the hosts, 17 from it!
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Another boundary for Fakhar. This is too short and wide, Zaman cuts it over point for another boundary.
SIX! Gets hold of this one and deposits this over long on for a biggie. Paul lands this full in line of the stumps, Zaman lofts it over long on for half a dozen.
FOUR! Short and wide, Fakhar square cuts this in the gap behind backward point for another boundary. You just cannot bowl to Zaman there.
Full on middle, Azam plays it towards mid on and gets to the other end quickly.
Keemo Paul to continue from the other end.
Short of a length again on middle and leg. Zaman rocks back and plays it into the ground.
FOUR! Bangs this one short around off, Fakhar charges down the pitch and slaps it in the gap through mid-wicket for a boundary. That went like a tracer bullet to the ropes.
Azam plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Back of a length ball on off, Babar hangs back and cuts it past point for a good looking boundary.
Digs this one short on middle, Fakhar gets in position and pulls it front of square for a run.
Bowls this on a good length and slants it into Fakhar who clips it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Rayad Emrit to bowl from the other end.
Ends the over with another dot. Length around off, Azam taps it in front of him and decides against the run.
Full around off, Babar gets low and drives this to the fielder at mid off this time.
Pitches this up on middle, Azam hits this to the fielder at mid on for a dot.
Back of a length ball outside off, Zaman drops it on the off side and quickly calls for the run.
Good length ball outside off, Zaman tries to cut this one but misses it.
FOUR! Boundary off the first ball! Comes charging in from round the wicket and serves this full around off. Fakhar leans forward and drives it through covers for the first boundary.
We are back for the second half. Fakhar Zaman and Babar Azam will open for Pakistan, while Keemo Paul will have a go at the openers first up. Let's roll...
